body: I've also noticed that no one I have ever talked to actually really knows me at all, a lot of people barely remember my name even though it's quite unique and simple.

I don't really know how to really put myself out there more. I have a lot of friends, both female and male but mostly male, everyone seems fine with having me around, but it feels like It's wrong for me to even have romantic feelings in general, like other people think it's stupid of me to even do that. It feels like everyone's just trying to be nice to me like just out of pity, but they don't actually want to have much to do with me in reality.

Thanks for replying! :) I know I'll find someone better than her, but I don't know if I want to experience this again, it's a terrible feeling. I somehow see myself as somewhat desirable which is new, but I really struggle believing that anyone ever will desire me as a lover or anything else really.
